The present writ application has been filed for a direction t

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the rate of lands for payment of compensation fixed by the Collector @ of Rs. 1800/- per Kattha is much less inasmuch as in the adjacent Mauza i.e.,
Tarauni and Paithan Kebai, rate of compensation was fixed @ Rs. 4,000/- per Kattha for the same type of land.

Learned counsel for the State submits that the acquisition proceeding was initiated in the year 1987-1988 for the purpose of construction of Koshi Canal and the awards were prepared in the matter of the petitioners in 1988.
Despite several notices sent to the petitioners for receiving the awards, the same have not been received by the petitioners and the compensation amounts have not been handed over to them.

Having heard the parties and taking into consideration the fact that acquisition proceeding has completed in the year 1988-1989, awards have been prepared in the name of the petitioners, notices were already sent to the petitioners to receive the awards, in my opinion, if the petitioners have got any objection with regard to the rate of land, the petitioners have appropriate remedy under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act 1984.
Patna High Court CWJC No.10781 of 2015(2) dt.13-01-2023
In that view of the matter, I do not find any merit in this writ application.
The same is dismissed.
